mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) signals inflationary pressure, which typically leads to monetary tightening by the Federal Reserve, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL increases > 0.5% month-over-month.

mechanism_narrative: A significant drop in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 4% signals a tightening labor market, which is typically associated with wage inflation and subsequent monetary tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances where UNRATE drops below 4%.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in housing starts (HOUST) signals strengthening demand in the housing sector, which is a leading indicator of broader economic growth, resulting in positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of instances where HOUST increases.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) signals weakening supply-side activity, which can lead to economic slowdown and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances where INDPRO decreases > 0.5% month-over-month.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of rising CPI (CPIAUCSL) and falling unemployment (UNRATE) signals inflationary pressure with tight labor markets, leading to aggressive monetary tightening and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: CPIAUCSL increases > 0.5% month-over-month AND UNRATE decreases < 4%
regime_hint: tight labor market with inflationary pressure
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL increases > 0.5% month-over-month AND UNRATE decreases < 4%.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp decline in retail sales (RSAFS) signals weakening consumer demand, which can lead to broader economic slowdown and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances where RSAFS decreases > 1% month-over-month.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) signals strengthening labor market conditions, which is typically associated with economic expansion and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of instances where PAYEMS increases.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals monetary easing, which typically leads to increased liquidity and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS decreases > 0.25%.
